subject: prd/impl-review
statement: If completed-report publication, native-receipt persistence or return, attempt-proof-reference persistence or return, receipt exact-read, EVT-13 append, reciprocal-host-terminal append, or the linked proposal projection fails or has an indeterminate outcome, then the system shall retry only under a closed versioned persistence policy carrying maximum attempts and an overall deadline, using FR-33's idempotency identity; reconcile only through the exact native receipt and distinct attempt-proof reference; at exhaustion emit one failed EVT-13 infrastructure terminal and refuse acceptance until one receipted proposal artifact, its proof reference, and its immutable reciprocal terminals are complete and losslessly consistent
intent: delayed evidence or a named bounded persistence/infrastructure failure, never silent loss, duplicate reports, inferred completion, or receipt/proof substitution
fit_criterion: a policy fixture proves no path exceeds its attempt/deadline bound; GitHub, Carina, response-loss-after-write, receipt-loss, proof-reference-loss, exact-read, event-append, and face-mismatch failures converge to one artifact/receipt/proof-reference/verified-terminal set or one failed terminal; process exit, body search, an unreceipted or unproved artifact, duplicate publication, or overloaded receipt/proof field never satisfies
